typography.font_strategy: Outfit for crisp, modern headings, Manrope for high-legibility body text. Avoid default system sans-serifs to ensure a premium look.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-slate-200. Radius: rounded-xl for modules to give a soft, premium feel.
visual_enhancers.interactions: Hover states on cards should have a subtle upward transform (-translate-y-[2px]) and increased shadow. Collapsible modules should animate height smoothly.

overall_progress_strip.layout: flex flex-nowrap w-full gap-3 pb-2 md:pb-0 md:grid
overall_progress_strip.columns_rule: Use inline styles or dynamic classes to set grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(0, 1fr)) based on module count to ensure equal widths.
overall_progress_strip.card_design: Flex row within each card: icon, text, and percentage at the end. White background, rounded-lg, subtle border, minimal padding (p-3).

grids_and_layouts.main_container: max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 space-y-6

module_collapsible.behavior: All modules collapsed by default. Use an Accordion or custom Collapsible pattern adapted to distinct card modules.
module_collapsible.design: White background, rounded-xl, 1px border. Header acts as trigger with a chevron on the right. Content area has generous padding (p-6).
module_collapsible.multiple_esg: Do NOT nest questionnaires. Each ESG questionnaire is a separate top-level collapsible module (e.g., 'ESG Questionnaire: Environment', 'ESG Questionnaire: Social').

revenue_information.header: Change from 'Revenue InformationOptional...' to simply 'Revenue Information'.

fields.revenue_percentage: Always mandatory. Add a red * next to the label.
fields.annual_revenue: Optional unless parent config says otherwise. Add * conditionally based on config.

revenue_information.layout: Grid with 2 columns on desktop for fields (gap-6).

progress_card.design: White background, brand green used sparingly (e.g., for the progress bar fill or icon tint). High contrast text.

motion.accordion: Use CSS transitions on max-height or use Framer Motion / Radix UI collapse animations (duration 200ms ease-out).
motion.hover: Transition transform and box-shadow on 200ms ease.

accessibility.aria_expanded: Ensure collapsible headers have aria-expanded attribute.
accessibility.contrast: Ensure green text/buttons meet WCAG AA contrast ratio against white/light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:ring-offset-2 for keyboard navigation.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium SaaS Supplier Assessment dashboard. It must look crisp, clean, and uncluttered.
Use .js/.jsx extensions instead of .tsx since the workspace is JS-based.
Strip out all off-white/yellow/grey background tones from existing module surfaces. Use pure white (#FFFFFF) for module cards and an extremely light grey (#FAFAFA) for the app background.
The 'Overall Progress' section must be a single responsive row. If there are 4 modules assigned, the strip divides into 4 equal width segments. Display: Icon, Module Name, and Percentage%.
Revenue Information Text rewrite: Just 'Revenue Information'.
Revenue Percentage is ALWAYS mandatory (mark with *). Annual Revenue is conditionally mandatory based on config (mark with * if mandatory, else leave normal).
All modules must be COLLAPSIBLE (like Accordions) and COLLAPSED BY DEFAULT.
For ESG Questionnaires: If there are multiple, each one must be its own independent collapsible module, not nested inside one parent ESG accordion.
Use 'lucide-react' for icons. (e.g. Activity, Leaf, FileText, BookOpen, DollarSign).
Preserve existing green accents but use them intentionally (e.g., progress bars, active states, key CTA). Do not flood the screen with green.
IMPORTANT: All interactive elements must have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Use generative UI spacing. Tailwind classes like p-6, p-8.
Never center align the main layout content. Keep forms and lists left-aligned.
Ensure input fields use proper styled appearances (rounded-lg, subtle border, focus ring).
Always apply hover, focus, and active states to interactive elements.
Avoid using generic system fonts. Use Outfit for headings and Manrope for body text.
Do NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
